description: Fetch current inventory products from Chirak, with options to filter by category or find critical low stock items.

category.description: Optional category name to filter products (e.g. 'Coffee', 'Clothing', 'General').

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default: 50, max: 100).

low_stock_only.description: If true, only returns products whose stock quantity is at or below the minimum threshold.

name: get_inventory

data.description: Result data payload from Chirak API.
